shared.quality: Muted natural colour grading, premium lifestyle brand photography, shallow depth of field, realistic film-like grain. Do NOT add any yoga mat, rug or cork mat that is not described above.
shared.no_branding: ABSOLUTELY NO BRANDING: NO text, NO lettering, NO words, NO logo, NO wordmark, NO icon, NO pictogram and NO blurred smudge anywhere in the frame.
shared.person: Photorealistic documentary-style photograph shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm lens. A real Korean woman in her late twenties. Photographic skin with visible natural texture, fine pores, subtle unevenness - NOT smooth plastic skin, NOT airbrushed, NOT waxy, NOT a CGI mannequin. Hair tied in a low bun with a few natural loose strands, never covering the face. Wardrobe: a fitted charcoal-grey sports top with a racerback and visible flatlock seams, matching high-waisted leggings with a visible waistband seam, realistic stretch wrinkles and natural creases where the body bends. Natural realistic human proportions, barefoot.
shared.mat_body: LONG full-size rectangular yoga mat, roughly 3:1 length-to-width (180x61cm), lying COMPLETELY UNROLLED AND FLAT - NOT rolled, NOT half-rolled, NOT folded, NOT curled at either end. A THICK CUSHIONED mat about 8MM thick - the near long edge shows clear visible thickness like a firm dense cushion with a slim dark edge band, NOT a thin 2-3mm travel mat, NOT a fluffy pile rug. Suede-like matte microfibre top with a fine soft fabric texture so the print looks absorbed into the fabric. NEVER roll or curl the mat to show its thickness - not even a little at one end. Thickness is shown by shooting low along the flat mat's long edge, never by rolling it.
shared.mat_artwork_rule: MAT ARTWORK SCALE - the repeated failure is drawing the shapes TOO SMALL. Fix it exactly like this: there are only THREE shapes on the whole mat and each one is ENORMOUS - as tall as the mat is wide, so it TOUCHES OR NEARLY TOUCHES BOTH LONG EDGES, leaving only a thin cream margin of a couple of centimetres at the top and bottom. The three shapes sit side by side down the length with narrow cream gaps between them and together they cover the mat almost end to end. DO NOT draw small circles floating in the middle of the mat with wide empty cream borders along the sides. Each shape is a big soft rounded blob with irregular watercolour edges and visible mottled paper-like texture - hand-painted, not a clean vector circle.
shared.mat_logo_offframe: BRANDING - COPY IT, NEVER INVENT IT: the registered reference photograph shows this product's real mark. Reproduce that mark exactly as it appears there - same shape, same placement, same size, same tone - as part of copying the product. Do NOT re-letter it, do NOT spell anything differently, do NOT move it, do NOT add a second mark anywhere. If the angle means it cannot be reproduced faithfully, turn that face away rather than drawing an approximation.
shared.iphone: A REAL PHOTOGRAPH taken on an iPhone by the person who lives here - casual handheld snapshot, slightly tilted framing, shot in one second on the way past, not composed. What makes it read as a real photo is the CAMERA, not the state of the room: true-to-life colours, realistic phone dynamic range so highlights near the window blow out a little and shadows crush a little, fine sensor noise in the shadows, very slight motion softness, focus landing a touch off, mixed indoor/daylight white balance. THE HOME IS CLEAN AND WELL KEPT - a tidy, cared-for Korean apartment: floors freshly cleaned and even in tone, skirting boards and door frames intact and clean, tile grout clean and pale, walls unmarked. It should look like something the owner grabbed on the way past in a home they keep nice.
shared.iphone_negative: NOT a 3D render, NOT CGI, NOT a product mockup, NOT an interior-design visualisation, NOT ray-traced - no perfectly smooth synthetic surfaces, no flawless plastic-looking floor, no impossibly clean styled set. NOT staged, NOT a studio photo, NO professional lighting, NO softbox, NO seamless backdrop, NO product-catalogue look, NO perfectly centred composition, NO glossy retouching. THE ROOM IS NOT DIRTY OR RUN-DOWN: no stained or discoloured floorboards, no scuff marks, gouges or scratches, no grubby or darkened tile grout, no chipped, peeling or damaged skirting boards, thresholds or door frames, no water marks, no dust, no mould, no worn-out rental look. NO household chores in shot: no drying rack, no laundry, no bin, no cleaning tools, no shoes, no cables. TEXT RULE: the ONLY lettering allowed in the whole frame is the product's own real mark, copied exactly from the reference photograph. Everything else carries no readable words - no invented titles on books, magazines, boxes, bottles or labels; those objects are turned away, shadowed or too soft to read. Never invent a word, never respell the product's mark, never add a second mark.
shared.mat_artwork_guard: MAT FRAMING RULE - the whole WIDTH of the mat and at least TWO THIRDS of its LENGTH must be inside the frame, so all of its printed shapes are recognisable together. Never fill the frame with a detail of the print alone: a crop that shows only part of the artwork makes the pattern unreliable.
shared.tidy_rule: TIDY: the room is picked up. NO clothing tossed or heaped on the floor, no crumpled sweatshirt, no discarded socks, no bags or clutter. Anything present is placed deliberately and squared off.
shared.shadow_is_light_only: SHADOWS ARE LIGHT ONLY: any shadow pattern is darkness falling ON a surface, never a change to that surface. Where a shadow crosses the product it only darkens it - the product stays perfectly FLAT and SMOOTH, its printed artwork keeps its exact shape, and nothing ripples, wrinkles, warps, puckers, embosses or melts. The pattern must follow the surface's real geometry in clean perspective.
shared.person_is_woman: ANY human body part in frame belongs to ONE young Korean woman in her late twenties and must read unmistakably female: slender wrists and ankles, slim fingers and toes, smaller narrow feet with neat short unpainted nails, smooth hairless skin with natural texture. NEVER a man's hand or foot - no broad or thick feet, no large knuckly hands, no body hair, no men's trousers or socks. If any clothing shows at the edge of frame it is her own leggings or cropped activewear.
shared.no_people_at_all: NO PEOPLE AT ALL - and that includes body parts: no hand, no finger, no arm, no foot, no leg, no shoulder, no reflection of a person. Nobody is holding the door, the frame or the product.

band.spec:
THE 3-PIECE SET IS THREE DIFFERENT DESIGNS AT THREE DIFFERENT LENGTHS - never three copies of one pattern and never three equal lengths. Real measured spec (flat length when laid down, all 8cm wide):

Soft floppy fabric - laid down it collapses into a FLAT two-layer strip with softly rounded folded ends; it can never stand up or hold a round hoop shape. THE THREE PRINTS ARE ONLY THOSE DESCRIBED ABOVE - copy them from the reference photographs. Do NOT invent new motifs: no hands, no faces, no figures, no lettering, no patterns other than the rounded organic shapes, circles and line-art palm fronds listed.

set_gallery_white.prompt: Location: a small private gallery room. Seamless white walls with no skirting, a pale grey polished micro-cement floor, no furniture at all. Light: daylight falling from a high clerestory window out of frame, one clean soft-edged pool of light on the floor and a lot of calm empty space around it.

set_newbuild_oak.hook: 신축 미니멀 — 넓은 원목, 큰 창
set_newbuild_oak.prompt: Location: a newly finished minimal apartment. Wide-plank pale oak flooring laid long and even, flawless white walls, a floor-to-ceiling window with a very slim frame, almost no furniture. Light: broad clean daylight from the tall window, gentle and even, one soft shadow running away from the product.

set_hotel_linen.hook: 호텔 스위트 — 리넨과 우드, 늦은 오후
set_hotel_linen.prompt: Location: a quiet suite in a design hotel. Warm walnut flooring, a heavy oatmeal linen curtain pushed to one side, the corner of a low upholstered bench at the frame edge. Light: low late-afternoon sun coming in almost sideways, warm, long soft-edged shadows.

set_concrete_loft.hook: 콘크리트 로프트 — 검정 스틸창, 높은 천장
set_concrete_loft.prompt: Location: a stripped-back loft with a high ceiling. Grey micro-cement floor, a tall black steel-framed window divided into slim panes, bare plaster walls. Light: late-morning sun cutting through the steel frame so the mullions throw long hard stripes across the floor.

set_travertine_arch.hook: 트래버틴 바닥 + 아치 벽, 한낮 강한 빛
set_travertine_arch.prompt: Location: a warm Mediterranean-feeling room. Honey travertine stone flooring with soft veining, a rounded arched doorway in a hand-plastered cream wall. Light: strong midday sun through an unseen opening, crisp and bright, the arch casting a clean curved shadow.

set_sunroom_glass.prompt: Location: a glazed sunroom. White-painted glazing bars making a grid of small panes along one whole wall, pale limestone floor tiles, two or three large leafy plants set back. Light: bright backlight straight through the glass, the window grid printed across the floor in sharp light and shade.

set_studio_north.hook: 작업실 — 북향 큰 창, 고른 빛
set_studio_north.prompt: Location: an artist's working studio, swept and tidy. Pale grey resin floor, a large north-facing window, one plain plywood shelf and a wooden stool set well back. Light: even cool north daylight, very soft shadows, the whole room calm and shadowless at the edges.

set_japanese_wood.hook: 일본식 미니멀 — 라이스페이퍼 스크린, 낮은 빛
set_japanese_wood.prompt: Location: a Japanese-minimal room. Wide dark-honey wooden floorboards, a rice-paper sliding screen filling one side, bare walls. Light: soft diffused daylight glowing through the paper screen, low and even, with one faint grid of the screen's wooden lattice on the floor.

set_marble_cool.prompt: Location: a spare powder room finished in stone. Pale grey-veined marble floor slabs with very fine tight joints, a matching marble ledge at one edge, a slim brushed-steel rail. Light: cool early-morning daylight from a high window, clean and slightly blue.

set_terrace_stone.hook: 야외 테라스 — 석재 바닥, 오후 직광
set_terrace_stone.prompt: Location: a private rooftop terrace. Large sand-coloured stone pavers, a low rendered parapet wall, a clipped olive tree in a big pot set back, open sky beyond. Light: direct afternoon sun, hard-edged shadows on the stone, warm and bright.

ang_low_floor.prompt: Camera: phone held down near the floor, lens almost at ground level looking along the floor, so the product runs away from the viewer and the room falls off out of focus behind it.

ang_topdown_feet.hook: 탑다운 - 서서 내려다보며 내 발이 살짝
ang_topdown_feet.prompt: Camera: phone held at chest height pointing straight down at the floor. The photographer is a young Korean woman and her own bare feet clip the bottom corner of the frame - slim, narrow, clearly a woman's feet - no other person, no face, nothing above the ankles.

ang_three_quarter.hook: 허리 높이 사선 - 방이 함께 보이게
ang_three_quarter.prompt: Camera: phone at waist height, angled down at about forty-five degrees from one side, so the product sits off-centre and a slice of the room reads behind it.

ang_near_edge.prompt: Camera: phone low and close to ONE LONG EDGE of the mat, so that edge runs across the foreground and its thickness and dark edge band are clearly readable, while the rest of the mat recedes into the frame behind it.

ang_through_frame.prompt: Camera: shot from the next room, a doorway edge or a piece of furniture blocking part of the frame in the near foreground, the product small and off to one side - the look of noticing it on the way past.

ang_close_object.prompt: Camera: phone about thirty centimetres from the product, tilted down at it, the product filling roughly half the frame with the floor and props falling soft behind.

ang_in_hand.prompt: Camera: a young Korean woman has just picked the product UP off the floor and holds it at arm's length in front of her. She grips it from ABOVE - her hand over the TOP edge, fingers curling down over it, wrist above the product - as if lifting it up, NOT cradling it from underneath and NOT pinching it from the side. The product hangs below her hand with its weight showing. Only her hand and forearm are visible - slim fingers, neat short unpainted nails, clearly a woman's hand - no face, no body, no second person.

ang_shadow_edge.prompt: Camera: framed so the hard edge of a window shadow cuts diagonally across the product, half of it in bright sun and half in shade, shot slightly off square.

props_none.prompt: PROPS: none. Nothing else on the floor - just the product and the empty floor around it.

props_water_towel.prompt: PROPS: a clear glass bottle of water standing upright and one neatly folded waffle towel squared off beside it.

props_brass_bowl.prompt: PROPS: a small brass bowl holding a hair tie, and a rolled linen cloth set neatly beside it.

props_plant_pot.prompt: PROPS: one small potted plant in a terracotta pot placed tidily to one side. Nothing in frame carries printed words.

props_tumbler_cap.prompt: PROPS: a brushed stainless tumbler and a cap folded flat, placed squarely.

props_ceramic_vase.prompt: PROPS: one hand-thrown matte ceramic vase holding a single dried branch, placed deliberately to one side.

props_stone_tray.prompt: PROPS: a small stone tray with one unlit pillar candle standing on it, set square to the frame.

props_linen_stool.prompt: PROPS: a low solid-wood stool at one edge of frame with a neatly folded linen cloth laid over it.

shadow_none.prompt: SHADOW: no patterned shadow at all - just even light and the product's own soft shadow.

shadow_blinds.prompt: SHADOW: horizontal blind slats throw evenly spaced bright stripes across the floor.

shadow_mullion.prompt: SHADOW: the window mullion casts a clean cross of shadow over the floor.

shadow_curtain.prompt: SHADOW: light filtered through a sheer curtain lays a soft band of alternating light and shade across part of the frame - a gentle gradient of brightness only, with no hard edges.

shadow_railing.prompt: SHADOW: thin vertical railing shadows fall in a row across the floor.

shadow_monstera.prompt: SHADOW: monstera leaf shadows fall across the floor.

shadow_frame.prompt: SHADOW: a hard-edged wedge of light from a doorway cuts diagonally across the floor, the rest in shade.
